patterns: APPSC asks who/which body: first NI estimate (Naoroji), first scientific (V.K.R.V. Rao), NI Committee chair (Mahalanobis), agency estimating NI/IIP (CSO, now NSO).
Base-year revision is a recurring one-liner: 2011-12 replaced 2004-05 (APPSC 2017, 2019, 2023); expect 2022-23 replacing 2011-12 next.
APPSC G2 has asked Arvind Subramanian's GDP-overestimation critique and 'statistical system designed by' (Mahalanobis, Rao, Sukhatme - all).
Several PSC keys in this bank are corrupted (ISI/NSSO/RBI keyed for CSO answers) - trust the established answer.
App MCQs are heavily current-affairs (2022-23 series, release calendar, PLFS 2025 reforms) and methodological (double deflation, SUT, institutional sectors) - much deeper than PYQs.
